03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill for one specific page: the Vector & Bitmap Graphic Finder, published as a Claude artifact. The page is a full vibe dashboard (same design, Search section, Mind Map, Glossary, and audio overview) with a live tool inside it. You describe a graphic, paste an image link, or drop an image, and Claude suggests where to find it as a vector or bitmap file, or as a 3D relief heightmap or relief model.

Around the tool, the page explains search operators, what makes a good vector or bitmap, file types, 3D relief heightmaps and depthmaps, how to vectorize a bitmap (with a table of tracing tools such as Potrace, Inkscape, and Vector Magic), and the finder's limits. The skill tells Claude where the page's build sources live, how to rebuild it, and which parts of the live tool must never be changed.

Called on its own, with no change asked, the skill simply opens the live finder so you can use it.

Why it mattersMakers who cut, carve, or print a design need a clean vector (SVG or DXF) or a high-quality bitmap. The finder turns a plain description into ranked sources and hand-off searches, and the reference sections explain what to look for and how to convert what you find.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Open the finderCalled as /vector-bitmap-graphic-finder with no change asked, it opens the live finder and gives you its link instead of rebuilding anything.
  • Live finderTakes a description, an image URL, or an uploaded image and asks Claude for ranked source links, shown in a sortable results table (Source, Type, Cost, CAD notes, Link).
  • FiltersFile-type chips (SVG, DXF, PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP) and style chips (Free only, Silhouette, Black & white, Color, Clipart), all on by default, plus 3D Relief chips (Heightmap, Depthmap, and Relief STL) that start off.
  • Hand-offsOne-click searches on Google, Bing, Brave, and DuckDuckGo, on the SVGrepo, FreeSVG, and Freepik vector sites, and on the 3D relief sites yeggi, STLFinder, and ambientCG, plus a Make a relief button that opens the Image to Relief Generator.
  • 3D reliefFinds grayscale heightmaps and depthmaps (white is high) for CNC 3D carving, laser 3D engraving, and lithophanes, and ready-made relief STL models, as separate filters and separate result types.
  • Reference sectionsSections on search operators, what makes a good vector or bitmap, file types, 3D relief heightmaps and depthmaps, vectorizing a bitmap, and the finder's limits and caveats.
  • 3D printing tipsClosed profiles, one closed shape per color, and details at least about two nozzle widths wide so the slicer keeps them.
  • Vibe dashboard partsDashboard Summary, Search, Mind Map, a 36-term Glossary, and a spoken audio overview, all from the vibe-dashboard skill.
  • Script-builtRebuilds from sources published with the page (build.txt, make.txt, tool-source.txt, narration.txt, check.txt), so every edit is repeatable.
  • CopiesCan make a separate copy of the finder, or use it as the base for a similar finder tool.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Three inputsDescribe it, paste an image link, or upload an image; uploads are shrunk in the browser before they are sent.
  • FallbacksIf Claude can't be reached, the page still offers Google and Bing links and every hand-off button.
  • Repeatable editsEvery change is a small edit to the build sources, rebuilt the same way each time.
  • Reusable baseThe tool and its build can be copied as a starting point for a similar finder.
  • No browsingClaude can't browse from the page, so the finder suggests well-known sites and their own search pages, not exact file links.
  • Image URLsImage URL mode often has to guess from the link text; Upload Image is the reliable way to search by picture.
  • Claude onlyThe main finder button needs Claude's built-in access, so it works only on the published claude.ai page. Elsewhere (opened from disk, or built by another AI) it shows an error banner, but the search-engine and vector-site buttons still work.
  • One pageThe skill is built around one artifact and its published sources; a new copy needs its own permissions and audio wiring.
  • Relief sitesThe 3D relief row has yeggi, STLFinder, and ambientCG. yeggi's search link hasn't been confirmed yet, and Etsy and CGTrader wait until their links are tested in a real browser.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Capital SearchOn the finder page, body text that starts a word with a capital-S "search" turns into a link to its search section. Say "the finder" or "run it" instead.
  • Category namesNever name a category search; the Search patch owns it. The tool's color is --cat-tool.
  • Audio droppedmake.sh rebuilds from scratch and drops the audio player. Save the live audio block first, or record again.
  • Stress checkEvery new narration gets the vibe-dashboard noun/verb stress audit before recording, so words like "record" and "research" are stressed correctly.
  • Model downloadIf the voice model download is cut off, delete the partial kokoro.onnx and retry once; then fall back to the browser voice.
  • Chip clicksThe tool's controls must be skipped by glossary and section linking, or a click on a filter chip jumps to the Glossary.
  • Live sourcesAlways build from the page's published sources, never an older copy; they hold every edit since the skill was last updated.
  • New windowsHand-off buttons open through a real link click, because window.open is unreliable inside the artifact viewer.

15GlossaryREFERENCE▶

Every term with a dotted underline in the dashboard links here — hover it for a quick definition, click it to land on its row. Each term's Topic tag names what it is about, one color per topic. In the Appears in column, each number is a jump link to where that term is used in that section (hover to preview the line); the term flashes green when you arrive. Qty counts every mention of the term across the content sections (everything except the summary, this glossary and the references), including repeats within a section.

TermTopicDefinitionAppears inQty
VectorGraphicsA graphic made of lines and curves that scales to any size without losing sharpness.
BitmapGraphicsA graphic made of a grid of pixels; it blurs or turns blocky when enlarged.
SVGFile FormatsScalable Vector Graphics, the common web vector format; most CAD and laser tools import it.
DXFFile FormatsDrawing Exchange Format, the CAD vector format most CNC, laser, and plasma software reads.
PNGFile FormatsA lossless bitmap format that supports transparency.
VectorizeTracingTurning a bitmap into vector paths by tracing its edges.
PotraceTracingA free tracing engine that turns black-and-white bitmaps into smooth vectors; Inkscape uses it.
Vector MagicTracingA paid automatic tracing service and desktop app known for clean, low-node results.
Closed profile3D PrintingAn outline that fully closes on itself, so CAD can extrude it into a solid.
Slicer3D PrintingThe program that turns a 3D model into printer layers and moves.
Nozzle width3D PrintingThe printer nozzle's opening, commonly 0.4 mm; it limits the finest printable detail.
Hand-offFinderA button that opens your query on another search engine or vector site in a new tab.
Search operatorFinderA special term like filetype: or site: that narrows a web search.
Sample capabilityBuildThe artifact permission that lets a published page ask Claude a question, with images if allowed.
Build sourcesBuildThe files published with the page that rebuild it exactly: generator, pipeline, tool source, narration, and checker.
ArtifactBuildA web page Claude publishes on claude.ai; it starts private.
HeightmapFinderA grayscale image where brightness is height, usually white high and black low, used to carve, engrave, or print a 3D relief.
